minimum_requirements: New records must contain all 21 required features
Actual diabetes outcome must be available
steps: Replace production model only if validation criteria are satisfied

data_requirements._status: PROPOSED defaults by the retraining pipeline — confirm thresholds with Hưng before quoting them in the report

split.historical_locked_test: Re-created exactly from training_params.json (never used for training)
split.new_data_holdout_assignment: Stable SHA-256 hash of prediction_id (Sheet rows) or of the 21 answers + label (dataset rows): a record in the holdout stays there in every future run and is never trained on

promotion_criteria.primary_evaluation_set: new-data holdout when it has enough outcomes, otherwise the locked test
